purpose: Apply the already-frozen paper account constraints and chronological ledger to an already-frozen label-blind historical scanner and Micro runtime, solely to obtain an immediate account-feasibility diagnostic while the separate prospective account panel accumulates.

sampling_contract.candidate_source: every causal-market-discovery-v0.2 activation retained by discretion-heldout-runtime-v0.1
sampling_contract.known_at_registration: Both source artifacts and their aggregate plan/fill counts already existed and had been inspected before this account overlay was registered; this is retrospective composition, not a held-out or prospective experiment.

candidate_contract.activation_anchor: exact scanner row matching the frozen Micro candidate_qualified_at
candidate_contract.account_profile_reapplication: apply the unchanged current-general-2026 or current-small-account-2026 thresholds to the exact causal activation row
candidate_contract.provider_news_semantics: publication-timed Alpaca/Benzinga provider presence is used only as the existing has_fresh_news boolean; headline catalyst quality remains unclassified
candidate_contract.rejected_candidate_behavior: retain the record and Micro hash but do not expose its plans or outcomes to the account ledger
candidate_contract.small_account_coverage: partial_same_anchor_overlap_only because the source discovery and Micro replay used the first general-profile market anchor; it can omit small-profile candidates priced from 1.50 through 1.99 and candidates first satisfying the small account profile after that anchor
candidate_contract.main_account_coverage: partial_same_anchor_overlap_only because account qualification is tested at the already-frozen market/Micro anchor rather than searching later scanner rows for a more favorable account-qualified activation; the source universe itself is also not full-walk-forward eligible

synthetic_account_contract.balance_semantics: Each historical session is an independent fixed-balance feasibility scenario. Profit, loss, positions, and buying power do not carry between sessions.
synthetic_account_contract.buying_power_assumption: cash-like buying power equal to starting equity; the unchanged 50 percent notional cap binds before this assumption can increase size

event_order: plan emissions before entry attempts at the same timestamp
exit fills after entry attempts at the same timestamp
chronology_and_sizing_contract.sizing_rule: maximum positive whole shares inside remaining buying power, starter, campaign and total notional, and campaign and total open-risk ceilings
chronology_and_sizing_contract.filled_open_behavior: remain open and unresolved; no session-close exit is invented

knowledge_policy.source_micro_outcome_role: already-frozen label-blind price-path evidence supplied only after account profile qualification

primary_outputs: per-session accepted and rejected entry events
ten-session sum of independently sized realized P&L
reporting_contract.return_denominator: fixed starting equity, not a compounded equity curve
